programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore takes families on a journey where history and adventure come together in unforgettable ways. From navigating the hedge maze at Vienna’s Schönbrunn Palace—once a playground for royalty—to wandering the lavish halls of Cairo’s Abdeen Palace, this trip is anything but ordinary. In Aswan, families pause for an elegant high tea at the Old Cataract Hotel, the very place where Agatha Christie wrote Death on the Nile. It’s a moment of calm and connection, with sweeping Nile views and Egyptian charm. The journey wraps in Prague, where a vintage Alfa Romeo transforms a sightseeing tour into a glamorous ride through history. More than just sightseeing, Family Travel celebrates curiosity, culture, and time spent together. Whether you're sipping tea or solving a maze, these experiences spark conversations—and memories—that last long after the trip is over.

Washington, explore the world's cleanest lake, relive their youth in a classic arcade museum, and visit with some critters native to the area!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick & Brian road trip to the great state of Michigan to the lakeside town of Grand Haven. Join them as they head out with the Coast Guard, meet an award winning brewmaster, go behind the scenes of a massive water fountain show, find a blueberry haven, and experience the delectable work of some incredible sandwich artisans!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick checks out the beautiful waterfront town of Scituate, Massachusetts. He experiences sport fishing, Irish mossing, homemade ice cream and lobster mac and cheese. Then he climbs the most expensive, musical water tower in the world.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick is on the road again and this time to a town that is right on the Erie Canal. Lockport, New York! He experiences a day in the life of a legendary Buffalo Bills fan. Then he chows down at Danny Sheehan's Steak House before exploring the underworld at the Lockport Caves.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This town is right on the banks of the Potomac River. Join Brian and Nick as they hit The Bavarian Inn, explore the town's history, make gourmet popcorn, and visit the battlefield that is known as The Bloodiest Day in American History.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick road trips to actress Katharine Hepburn's hometown of Old Saybrook. He tours The Kate, learns what the locals are doing to revive the oyster beds, cooks up some sea scallops at Liv's, and hits the shores in search of oystercatchers.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Wellsboro PA aka The Town That Saved Christmas is a classic storybook town with nostalgic gas-lit streets. Nick quickly finds out about its glassmaking past and comes across a chocolate factory with an incredible mission. He chows down at the Steak House and travels deep into the PA Grand Canyon!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick rolls into to this central pa town and visits the historic Campus Theater where he satisfies one of his life long quests. Then he checks out a restaurant that has mastered the art of the smashburger! He'll witness the making of some of the best snowboards in the world, then close out this road trip by hitting Mecum's Auto Auction where the Caddy awaits him after its new restoration.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This gem in the beautiful Mountain State is known for its connection to John Brown's raid. Hop in the seat and ride along as Nick travels back in time to a candy store that uses centuries old recipes and chows down at a restaurant specializing in vegan delights. Then take a walk on the Appalachian Trail with an AT Legend!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This historic town northwest of Boston played a significant role in the American Revolutionary War. Come along as Nick explores the Minuteman National Historical Park, visits the Concord Museum, and takes a stroll through Authors Ridge, the resting place of famous authors such as Henry David Thoreau and Ralph Waldo Emerson. Discover the rich history of this charming New England town.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick check out the Caboose Motel, indulge in delicious eats at Fat Chad's, and learn about the influential journalist Ida Tarbell. They make some smiley cookies and of course find out all they can about the birthplace of the oil industry and the global impact Titusville had on the rest of the world.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick travels to a New Jersey beach town known as "the bubble" where he visits not one but two chocolate shops that make time tested treats. Then he hits a seafood restaurant serving the freshest of fresh blue fin tuna. He tours a historic home, visits the local theater and museum then rides drop top around town to take in the stunning residential architecture.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick stays at the historic Gage Mansion, hits the 1000 Steps to learn about a rock that made history, visits the nation's oldest car museum and a place with over 40,000 artifacts.
